chunks: The sinners will see the Fire and know that they will be thrown into it and will not find a way of escape from it.

key_terms.الْمُجْرِمُونَ: The sinners, those who committed crimes against God and self
key_terms.مَصْرِفًا: A means of diversion or escape
key_terms.مُوَاقِعُوهَا: Those who will encounter/be thrown into it

ai.seo_question: What will the sinners realize when they see the Hellfire?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological state of the 'al-mujrimun' as they transition from denial to absolute certainty ('zannu annahum') regarding their fate. The phrase 'wa lam yajidu anha masrafan' underscores the finality of divine justice, where no intercession or alternative path remains, reinforcing the concept of 'Barzakh' as the intermediate realm where this realization often begins before the final resurrection.
